newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer, Yelstin jitters support.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer, Yelstin jitters support.

text.p: SIMEX December Brent futures were slightly firmer in late afternoon dealings on Tuesday, finding modest support from jitters over Boris Yeltsin's heart surgery.
The Russian president is undergoing heart surgery and has handed power over to Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin during the time of the operation.
Brokers said the latest U.S. report that one of its fighters had fired a missile at an Iraqi anti-aircraft system on Monday was largely shrugged off, but offered some underlying support.
December Brent was last traded at $22.30 per barrel, up two cents from London's close on Monday. The contract fell 22 cents in London.
NYMEX December crude, which fell 24 cents in New York to $22.79, was last traded at $22.85 on the after-hours ACCESS system.
Brokers said they expected the December Brent contract to range $22.00 to $22.90 for the time being in the absence of fresh news.
